name: Nikko
blurb: Nikko offers mountain air, ancient cedar forests, and historical sites like Tokugawa's mausoleum and the Shinkyo bridge. Online discussion highlights a 114% increase in conversation compared to baseline levels.

positive: Appreciated cool weather and mountain air
Fascinated by intricate animal carvings and historic architecture
Enjoyed local food specialties like yuba and Nikko pudding
negative: Experienced train delays on the Tobu Nikko Line due to earthquakes, weather, and fallen trees
Noted power outages and weather disruptions

quotes.text:
Nikko is a perfect place for creators to get inspiration. 
The animal carvings are amazing, showing incredible three-dimensional beauty and muscle details for their time. It is also famous for the Three Wise Monkeys and the Sleeping Cat.
(BTW, the Sleeping Cat is seriously tiny!)
Wonderful day exploring Nikko, getting some mountain air before we descend on Kamakura for #IFPA2026. Visited the oldest shrine in Japan in ancient cedar forests. Beautiful
back in tokyo with the tokyo heat... i will miss the cool nikko weather
